title: Admin Flagset: Organizational Compliance Controls (IP allowlist, sharing disable, export locks)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Build a coherent admin-facing flagset that lets org admins enforce three org-wide compliance controls: (1) IP allowlisting for console/API access, (2) disable public/sharable links and external sharing, and (3) granular data export locks (CSV/JSON/archive) with optional encryption/HSM gating. These toggles must integrate with RBAC v2, emit structured audit logs, and respect SSO/SAML role/group mappings so that identity providers can be the source of truth for who may flip these controls.

Goals:
- Provide a single Admin → Compliance controls page in Console and API endpoints for programmatic enforcement.
- Ensure all changes are captured in immutable audit logs with before/after states, actor identity (including SAML group if present), timestamp, and request_id.
- Make toggles effective across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private installs; for Private, provide a config file + migration guide.
- Support org-wide hard enforcement (cannot be overridden by team-level settings) and a secondary softer enforcement mode (warnings + telemetry).

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not add per-object DLP (data classification) or content-aware export redaction. Those will follow in separate work.

High-level UX/API:
- Console: Admin > Security > Compliance Controls: three toggles with explainer text, change history, and ability to schedule activation.
- API: PATCH /orgs/{org_id}/compliance-controls with boolean flags, reason, and optional schedule metadata.
- Events: Emit AuditEvent change.type = "compliance_toggle" and include fields changed, previous_value, new_value, actor.identity_source (local|sso|api-key), actor.principal, request_id.

Security model notes:
- Only principals with the Admin permission (per RBAC v2) may change toggles. For SAML SSO, we map IdP groups -> RBAC roles; ensure enforcement consults IdP-mapped roles at change time and records group metadata in the audit event.
- For Dedicated and Private, toggles should be able to be set via a read-only config file for air-gapped environments; changing requires operator credentials and logs to local audit sink.

Compliance considerations:
- Exports disabled must also be enforced at API, SDK, and console file-download endpoints.
- IP allowlist must apply to non-interactive API tokens, web console sessions, and websocket/streaming endpoints.
- Audit logs must be tamper-evident; initial implementation will append signed audit entries to the centralized audit store and include a content-hash for off-platform verification.
acceptance_criteria: Console and API exist to read and set the three compliance toggles
RBAC v2 gating prevents non-admins from modifying toggles; SAML group->role mapping respected
Every toggle change emits a structured audit event (actor, identity_source, diff, request_id) stored in the audit log and visible in Console history view
IP allowlist rejects console logins and API requests from non-allowlisted IPs for orgs with the toggle enabled
Public sharing endpoints return 403 and UI hides shareable link options when sharing is disabled
Export endpoints return 403 and client SDKs surface clear error codes when export locks are active
Dedicated/Private config path documented and includes migration steps; changes generate local audit entries
implementation_notes: Backend: Add org_compliance_controls table with columns: org_id, ip_allowlist_enabled, sharing_disabled, exports_locked, updated_by, updated_at, change_reason. (Migration + index on org_id)
API: Secure PATCH/GET endpoints; validate actor role via RBAC v2 decision service (cache TTL 30s). Include schedule metadata for delayed activation.
Console: New admin page with explainers, toggle controls, scheduling UI, and history panel (show last 30 changes). Use existing settings style tokens.

Auth integration: When acting users are from SAML SSO, include idp_group list in audit event and prefer IdP-mapped role for gating decisions. Ensure live re-evaluation on change (so a user's admin status revocation is honored immediately).

Enforcement: Middleware to check compliance flags for every request path that can export data or create shareable URLs. Add checks in streaming/token endpoints for IP allowlist enforcement (X-Forwarded-For and proxy header validation).
Audit logging: Use structured JSON events written to the audit pipeline. Include before/after diffs. Sign entries server-side and emit a short hash to the UI for verification.
Private/Dedicated: Expose CLI config => /etc/redwood/compliance.yaml with same fields; changing the file must create a signed local audit entry. Provide operator script to rotate enforcement keys.

Performance: Keep enforcement checks cheap (boolean reads). Use in-memory org-level cache with invalidation on change to avoid per-request DB hits. Cache TTL 1 minute; invalidation via pub/sub from change endpoint.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary - Hosted): Ship API + Console toggles for 5 internal orgs and Redwood Security team; collect metrics and audit log integrity checks
Phase 2 (Beta): Expand to 50 orgs including a mix of PLG and mid-market customers; enable SAML metadata recording and Dedicated config guidance
Phase 3 (GA): Open to all orgs. Add scheduled activation and UI history retention to 90 days; turn on tamper-evidence signatures
Feature flag gating: initial rollout behind feature flag 'compliance-flagset-v2' per-org
Migration: Provide backward-compatible read path for legacy per-team flags; block-warn migration during Phase 1 and automatic conversion tooling in Phase 2
testing_and_validation: Unit tests for API permission checks and scheduled activation logic
Integration tests that simulate SAML IdP role changes and verify immediate enforcement
E2E test: Attempt download/export/share from various clients (console, curl, SDK) for an org with toggles enabled => expect 403 and audit event
Load test: Ensure middleware enforcement adds <2% CPU and <1ms p95 latency on common request paths
Audit integrity test: Verify signed audit events can be verified by off-platform verifier script
Manual QA checklist for Private: test config file change, local audit write, and operator rotation script
monitoring_and_metrics: metric.audit.events.latency (time to write to audit store)
SLO: audit events must persist to primary store within 5s for 99.9% of events
Alert: sudden spike in toggle flips (>10 flips/org/day) triggers security-on-call paging
Dashboards: per-org compliance status with last-change actor and reason visible in Console
